column1: text
Artificial intelligence helps computers perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.
Machine learning allows systems to learn patterns from data and improve their predictions.
Natural language processing enables computers to understand and process human language.
Large language models can generate text by predicting the next token from context.
Text embeddings represent sentences as numerical vectors that capture semantic meaning.
Sentence transformers are useful for comparing the meaning of different sentences.
Semantic search finds information based on meaning rather than exact keyword matching.
Retrieval augmented generation combines document retrieval with language model generation.
Python is widely used for building machine learning and natural language processing applications.
Students can use Python to preprocess text, create embeddings, and analyze similarity.
A vector database stores numerical representations of documents for efficient similarity search.
Cosine similarity measures how closely two vectors point in the same direction.
A high cosine similarity score usually indicates that two sentences have related meanings.
An unrelated sentence about cooking may have low similarity to a sentence about artificial intelligence.
Cloud computing provides scalable resources for training and deploying machine learning models.
Cybersecurity systems can use artificial intelligence to detect unusual patterns and threats.
Recommendation systems use user and item information to suggest relevant content.
Data preprocessing improves the quality of text before it is used by an embedding model.
Transformers use attention mechanisms to capture relationships between words in a sequence.
Embeddings are important for semantic search, document retrieval, recommendation, and RAG applications.
